Emma T.: quick sync request — Customer Phoenix wants a security review call + artifacts: RBAC change window process, audit-log export sample, and KMS key access flow for tenant onboarding. can we do 30m today?
Raj P.: 11:30-12:00 works. we should include retention policy and where raw logs come from (cloudtrail/syslog).
Olivia (eng-sre): i'll bring the audit retention matrix. export example for portal logs:
```bash
# export last 7 days of api-audit logs
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  "https://logs.redwood.example/api/audit?start=2026-03-01T00:00:00Z&end=2026-03-08T00:00:00Z&format=json" \n  -o phoenix-audit-7d.json
```
Samir K.: RBAC flow: 1) change request in runbook -> 2) approver signs off -> 3) infra-job applies change and writes signed changelog to S3 prefix `rbac-change-log`. we can show signed log + job id.
Kate L.: KMS brief — Dedicated/Private support tenant-managed keys (BYOK) and Redwood-managed keys. BYOK uses envelope encryption: data key generated in HSM -> used for volume/kv encryption -> wrapped with tenant key. rotation evidence: `GenerateDataKey` / `Encrypt` logs and wrapping key version. provide HSM attestation for onprem.
Raj P.: vuln triage: scanner flagged `libproto` 2.1.3 (CVE-2026-0456). mitigated by pinning to 2.2.0 + input sanitizer in parser. remediation PR #4221. include summary in SQ response.
Emma T.: incident response / chain of custody — customer asked about emergency key rotations and evidence. paste playbook snippet?
Olivia (eng-sre): runbook excerpt:
- IR triage opens ticket in Zendesk with incident id
- create ephemeral audit snapshot: `aws s3 cp s3://rbac-change-log/<prefix> /tmp/ir-snapshot --recursive` and capture metadata
- produce signed manifest: `./sign-manifest --input /tmp/ir-snapshot --key /opt/attest/hsm-key.pem > manifest.sig`
- share manifest.sig + snapshot under NDA
Samir K.: we never expose raw KMS root key material. provide key usage logs + HSM attestations. for Dedicated we can offer live key ceremony.
Kate L.: sample KMS audit entries:
{"event":"GenerateDataKey","principal":"service:rdw-ingest","key_id":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd","time":"2026-03-05T14:12:33Z","status":"Success"}
{"event":"Encrypt","principal":"service:rdw-storage","key_id":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd","time":"2026-03-05T14:12:34Z","status":"Success"}
Emma T.: action items: Olivia bring retention & signed export steps, Kate bring KMS audit sample + attestation options, Samir bring RBAC changelog example + signed job id, Raj prepare vuln triage summary + PR link. i'll book 30m and invite Phoenix security.
